text.en: Many leaves show rust and the rains are close. Copper goes on just before the rains and again three weeks later, on a dry day. Ask the cooperative which product, how much, and what to do if heavy rain falls.
text.sw: Kutu ya majani imeonekana kwenye majani mengi na mvua za vuli au za masika zinakaribia. Dawa ya shaba hunyunyizwa siku kavu kabla ya mvua na tena baada ya wiki tatu. Uliza chama cha ushirika dawa gani, kiasi gani, na ufanye nini mvua kubwa ikinyesha.

not_sure.en: We cannot see your trees' variety or the berries. If your trees are Ruiru 11 or Batian, tell the officer before you spray for rust.
not_sure.sw: Hatuwezi kuona aina ya miti yako wala matunda. Kama miti yako ni Ruiru 11 au Batian, mwambie afisa wa kilimo kabla ya kunyunyiza dawa ya kutu ya majani.

note: 'Many' = 3 or more of 10 leaves: assumption, officer to confirm. Timing from S03. Fires in pre_short_rains and pre_long_rains, so Swahili names both seasons (vuli, masika). Kikuyu removed Sun 4 Oct (F20): the old draft did not match the en/sw card in full.

text.en: Some leaves show other spots that need the officer's eye. Ask the officer before you spray anything, and ask about fertiliser too: spots like these are often worse on underfed trees.
